title: Comparison refuses a block content control or a note that is empty in one version
symptom: compare refuses a block content control that holds nothing in one version and paragraphs in the other ("cannot give an empty block content control content, nor take all of it"): the last paragraph mark of a control's content cannot be taken out, as the body's last cannot; and it refuses a footnote or endnote with no paragraph added or removed whole ("content fragment has no root element")
workaround: give the empty control or note one empty paragraph in that version before comparing
